request.prompt: Animate ONLY the single reference fighter, facing RIGHT, fixed side-view camera. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, identical costume, silhouette, palette and proportions. Solid flat #ff00ff background throughout, no floor, no shadows, no camera motion, no opponent, no text. Keep the entire actor, longest extensions and all props at least 15% away from EVERY camera edge through the whole motion; do not zoom in. Animate in place; the game engine supplies world movement. Action: jump — the airborne arc: crouch-load, push-off, rising, apex, then descent. Interpret these six frame roles as six consecutive key moments of this video: frame 1 = crouch-load anticipation, frame 2 = push-off leaving the ground, frame 3 = rising, frame 4 = apex at peak height, frame 5 = beginning to descend, frame 6 = falling/descent pose (the held airborne pose the engine holds while falling). CHARACTER BODY PASS ONLY: no explosions, muzzle flashes, impact bursts, detached projectiles or lingering trails. Those are separate runtime VFX/entities, not pixels baked into this body animation. Motion brief: Squat violet hermit-crab locksmith with a huge purple spiral shell, brass padlock details, pale eyes, oversized brass key claw, small purple claw, two sturdy boot legs. Side-view crisp 16-bit pixel art, always facing right. Move: jump — the airborne arc: crouch-load, push-off, rising, apex, then descent. Side-view fighting game sprite row. Magenta background, full body visible, generous gutters, no cropping.
